result.question: What did captain say in letter to Felix?

readings.answer: It involved their law and had no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
readings.support: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.

readings.answer: He sent him to Felix at once.
readings.support: I sent him to you at once.

readings.answer: He instructed the accusers to present their case before Felix.
readings.support: I also instructed his accusers to present their case against him before you.

readings.answer: He had brought him to their Sanhedrin to understand the charges.
readings.support: since I wanted to understand their charges against him, I brought him down to their Sanhedrin.
